title: 社长公告
excerpt: 鉴于部分社员喜欢摔拍，在此声明：为保护社团公共设施，请摔拍时不要往球台上摔，可以选择往地上摔或者扔水池里等其他方式，感谢配合。
content: 鉴于部分社员喜欢摔拍，在此声明：为保护社团公共设施，请摔拍时不要往球台上摔，可以选择往地上摔或者扔水池里等其他方式，感谢配合。
excerpt_en: Since some members like to smash their paddles, a formal notice: to protect the club's shared facilities, please do not throw your paddle onto the table when you smash it — you are welcome to smash it on the ground or throw it into a pool instead. Thanks for your cooperation.
content_en: Since some members like to smash their paddles, a formal notice: to protect the club's shared facilities, please do not throw your paddle onto the table when you smash it — you are welcome to smash it on the ground or throw it into a pool instead. Thanks for your cooperation.
